Hi Ana,

Quick follow on INV-33421 (attached). We're planning the month-end cash sweep and need a firm payment date to ensure it lands in this cycle. Preferred route is ACH (same-day ACH if possible) — if AP needs to wire instead, please confirm and share a proof-of-funds or bank confirmation so we can align ledger posting.

Options to close this week:
- ACH by EOD 10/27 (best)
- Wire by 10/28 with proof-of-funds attached
- Virtual card now (we can accept with no additional paperwork)

Can you confirm which path AP will take and the expected settlement date? I've attached the invoice and our W9 for AP's records.

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note.

Quick answers from AP: they can do a wire but need "vendor remit details" and a PO reference to map the payment (our systems block unmatched invoices). PO is PO-4421, can you confirm that maps to INV-33421? Also, AP can't process same-day ACH for new vendors without a brief vendor risk check — they asked for a copy of a banking confirmation or a test deposit receipt before ACH goes live.

If you can confirm the PO mapping and the preferred wire instructions or provide a short bank confirmation, AP will schedule the wire for 10/28. Otherwise they can provision the vendor for ACH but it will likely not clear until 10/30.

— Ana
